meta.name: Red Eye
meta.description: London police officer DC Hana Li is escorting Dr Matthew Nolan back to Beijing where he has been accused of a crime. However, on board flight 357, she finds herself embroiled in an escalating conspiracy and a growing number of murders.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: A British man crashes his car in Beijing and upon his return, he's accused of murder. After an incident on board, the officer escorting him begins to suspect foul play.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: As Nolan fears for his life, tensions rise on board; Hana is instructed to investigate by the head of MI5 Delaney; Hana's sister starts digging into the events occurring on NCA 357.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Nolan recounts the events in Beijing; Hana continues to investigate the events on board; Jess's findings lead her to a mysterious international medical company.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Jess fears for her life when she becomes a target for both MI5 and a deadly assassin; Delaney uncovers a shocking truth that changes her understanding of events that night.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: The truth about events on board is revealed, forcing Hana to take drastic action; Tennant is put in charge of Delaney's operation, forcing Delaney to break protocol.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: The events of the fateful night in Beijing are revealed. Hana and Delaney hatch a daring plan, risking their lives to bring those responsible for the conspiracy to justice.
